messages:
Rebecca: Heads-up — SOC2/ISO control evidence mapping for KMS/HSM + audit logs. Need to confirm owners and dates for each evidence item by Thu EOD (auditor window next week). Starting this thread for async coordination. @Samir @Jun can you pick up KMS/HSM? @Maria please own audit log retention and forwarding.

Samir: I can take key rotation proof + rotation runbook. Will assemble evidence and upload to the control drive today.

Jun: I'll own HSM inventory + attestations. Need infra to export device list — @devinfra-bot any ETA on an inventory export?

devinfra-bot: Deploy bot: exported hsm-inventory CSV to s3://redwood-sec/hsm-inv/175600. Gave read perms to sec-team-role. :white_check_mark:

Maria: I'll do audit retention config + SIEM forwarder. Plan: update CloudWatch->Sumo rule, set retention to 7y, create PR with diffs.

Miguel: For evidence format — do auditors want signed attestations or are screenshots/config diffs enough? cc @Rebecca

Rebecca: Signed attestations preferred for HSM inventory/chain-of-custody. For audit logs, config diffs + retention screenshots are acceptable. We'll record exact evidence types in the control-evidence doc and in the JIRA ticket.

Samir: Draft checklist (will upload files):
```
- key_rotation_policy.md (owner: Samir)
- rotation_runbook.md (owner: Samir)
- rotation_execution_log-2026-02.csv (owner: Samir)
- hsm_inventory.csv (owner: Jun)
- hsm_attestation_signed.pdf (owner: Jun)
- kms_audit_config.json (owner: Maria)
- siem_forwarder_config.diff (owner: Maria)
```

Jun: Quick ask — can we stretch to Fri EOD for handoff? Need a day to validate attestations with vendor. 

Rebecca: We have an auditor window starting Monday; internal evidence needs to be in the tracker by Thu EOD. Can everyone aim for Thu? If a blocker, call it out explicitly here so we can escalate.

Maria: Thu works for me.

Samir: I'll aim for Wed EOD to leave room for review, but Thu latest.

Miguel: I'll prepare the evidence template and post link here in 1 hour so people can drop artifacts.

Rebecca: Great — I'll create the JIRA ticket, assign owners per checklist, and update the control-evidence doc. Please paste PR/drive links here when ready. Thanks! :thumbsup:
